fusions.name: Barbed Weave
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that catches the target on barbs woven through your mesh, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Trotline
fusions.desc: Casts 3 barbed lines in a spread, each dealing 10 damage to the first enemy it meets. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Barbed Mantle
fusions.desc: Wraps you in a barbed mesh: for 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Set the Barb
fusions.desc: Every hit you land sets a barb of your mesh in that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all tear free at once and heal you for 5% of your maximum health per barb (25% at full). Unfed, a barb slips out every 4 seconds.
